title: Flock Safety cuts staff and faces lawsuits over misuse of surveillance cameras
summary: The license plate reader camera company lays off 18% of its staff as legal and community controversies arise over its surveillance technology.

title: Ukraine attacks Yandex data centers and eliminates Russian disinformation bot traffic
summary: Ukrainian drone attacks disable multiple Yandex data centers, drastically reducing automated Russian propaganda online.

title: Tech moguls adopt Trump's term 'superintelligence' to describe advanced AI
summary: Following the presidential redefinition, leaders like Nadella use 'superintelligence' in their speeches, sparking debate over the technical accuracy of the concept.

title: California sues Polymaker for selling 3D filament as 'firearm precursor part'
summary: The state accuses the company of marketing harmless PLA filament to the 3D-printed gun community, turning it into a regulated component.

title: U.S. tests Ghost system: 10-ton capsules from orbit to Earth in 90 minutes
summary: The military-backed Ghost vehicle completes its first real-world test for ultra-fast global supply delivery from space.

title: Cyberleek threatens to leak full GTA 6 version if Take-Two doesn't pay 30 million in cryptocurrency
summary: The hacker demands a public apology and payment in memecoin in exchange for not releasing the playable build of Rockstar's highly anticipated game.

title: Nadella warns AI has advanced too fast and calls for 'emergency button' to contain it
summary: Microsoft CEO demands assuming all models are compromised and developing immediate shutdown mechanisms before it's too late.

title: Creator of free Adobe alternatives launches open-source clones of Excel, PowerPoint, and Word
summary: The developer behind the Adobe replicas releases free versions of Microsoft's office suite, with plans for more proprietary tools.
